verdict.rationale: Browserbase offers agent web search, URL-to-JSON/markdown fetching, and 30+ generic templates. None of the evidence documents a preset configuration tuned for research agents, or output that is structured and citable with source attributions. These features are adjacent building blocks, not the named capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can apply a preset configuration tuned for research agents that returns structured, citable output
